parameters: I was going to put you down myself, but then I think you made mom a little angry.

You people don't understand...\| That cult...\| They are insane!!\! You know they think their god is coming back to rule this world?! I had no choice... I had no choice!!\! Everything that transpired was of their design... my only desire was to become the legitimate Emperor...
Relax, it's only a flesh wound. You'll be wide awake for what's coming.
Goodbye, Casamir.\! Give my regards to... whatever god tortures you in the afterlife.
Aggh!! W-what... no, I don't believe it! I can't!
